Discover the Ideal Dinner Spot
Sep 2024 • Couples
Recently, I had the chance to visit a fantastic European restaurant right in the heart of the city. The first impression was its modern ambiance, but the real surprise was the cool, green garden inside. The place serves coffee during the day and switches to standard fine dining European dishes in the evening with excellent quality and presentation. I particularly loved the Duck Salad and Skirt Steak, both impeccably prepared with delicious flavors. Ideal not just for dates, the restaurant is also family-friendly with a play area for kids. Definitely going back!
